author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Drawing is hard, even with the help of AI generating images.

I am still at the imitation phase of learning, use AI to generate lots of image on different art style, to build up my visual vocabulary. In the past, I found the art history book are very boring, who cares about those old painting on those boring themes, like nobles and kings , religious figures.

With the help of AI, I can separate style from the content, I generate anime girls in all the historical art style. Now, art history is fun to learn.

If you are curious, here is my anime girl in 105 different art styles. I really grill ChatGPT hard, at the end it even come up with Egyptian drawing or indigeous art. I know this list is exhaustive.

https://lnkd.in/gWBAVJc8

shared_article.title: One model. One café. 105 ways to make a picture.
